title: No Boat Cheesing
description: Prevents you from using boats to avoid fighting mobs
body:
With this mod, you can not longer use boats or minecarts to avoid fighting hostile mobs.

Instead, mobs will leave their vehicle if they are targeting something, fleeing from danger, or tempted by food.

In all other cases, the default vanilla behavior will remain. Transportation contraptions will still work as long as mobs aren't focused on anything else.

This will also help make the game feel more immersive, as mobs will behave in a way that makes more sense.
